name: flc-anniversaries
description: WordPress plugin to display club member anniversaries for the current month.

scripts.plugin:zip: npm run build && cd .. && zip -r flc-anniversaries.zip flc-anniversaries -x 'flc-anniversaries/node_modules/*' -x 'flc-anniversaries/src/*' -x 'flc-anniversaries/.git/*' -x 'flc-anniversaries/.claude/*' -x 'flc-anniversaries/CLAUDE.md' -x 'flc-anniversaries/.gitignore' -x 'flc-anniversaries/package*.json' -x 'flc-anniversaries/vendor/*' -x 'flc-anniversaries/tests/*' -x 'flc-anniversaries/data/*' -x 'flc-anniversaries/composer.json' -x 'flc-anniversaries/composer.lock' -x 'flc-anniversaries/phpunit.xml' -x 'flc-anniversaries/.phpunit.result.cache'
